passives.name: Heir of Glory
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Increases damage taken from Light and Dark enemies. Reduces Speed of Fire, Water, and Earth enemies. This effect cannot be removed. Reduces damage taken from skills other than Burst Skills, Dual Attacks, and Skill Chains, and does not take Weakness Gauge damage. Greatly reduces damage taken by Fire, Water, and Earth enemies, and does not take Weakness Gauge damage. Damage from Cursed/fixed damage does not exceed [Buff_V_4086007_4_28].

buffs.summary: −9999.9% damage to boss if attacker is Earth
−9999.9% damage to boss if attacker is Water
−9999.9% damage to boss if attacker is Fire
